request.query: If 0 < 2m+1, delta times m is less than one, and 2m+1 ≤ delta squared times L, then m times (2m+1) divided by delta is less than L

items.name: Finset.mulConst_le_divConst_sq
items.type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] [inst_1 : DecidableEq G] {A : Finset G}, A.mulConst A ≤ A.divConst A ^ 2

items.name: num_le_nat_mul_den
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup M] [inst_1 : LinearOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] [inst_3 : One M]
  [ZeroLEOneClass M] [NeZero 1] {num : ℤ} {den : ℕ} {x : M}, num • 1 ≤ den • x → ∀ {n : ℤ}, x ≤ n • 1 → num ≤ n * ↑den

items.name: Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp.lt_eq_cancel_lt
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [PosMulStrictMono M] [PosMulReflectLT M]
  {e₁ e₂ f₁ f₂ L : M}, e₁ = L * f₁ → e₂ = L * f₂ → 0 < L → (e₁ < e₂) = (f₁ < f₂)

items.name: Finset.divConst_le_mulConst_sq
items.type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : DecidableEq G] {A : Finset G}, A.divConst A ≤ A.mulConst A ^ 2
